title: Absorb serverless handlers into Aws Lambda
description:
As a privacy engineer viewing a scan diagram, I want AWS Lambda entrypoint handlers absorbed into the Aws Lambda managed service node (with file:line evidence retained), so that I do not see a separate noisy Aws Lambda Handler bubble next to the backend hub.

## Not included
- Canvas parent/child nesting of handlers under Lambda
- Collapsing Terraform aws_lambda_function resources (those stay as managed assets)

## Gherkin

Feature: Collapse serverless handlers into Aws Lambda

Scenario: Backend Nest Lambda entrypoint is absorbed
  Given a section has a main-application hub and an Aws Lambda managed service
  And a serverless handler asset was detected from lambda_handler findings
  When connectivity repairs run
  Then the serverless handler asset is not present in the graph
  And the Aws Lambda node retains the handler source locations
  And the section hub has a flow to Aws Lambda
  And no disconnected_handler red flag is raised for that handler
